data.name: AutoPopulateGroceryList
data.value: INSERT INTO list_items (list_id, list_item_content, created_on, deleted, created_by, last_modified_on, last_modified_by, grocery_price, quantity, purchased) SELECT @list_id as list_id, li.list_item_content as list_item_content, @created_on as created_on, 0 as deleted, @created_by as created_by, @last_modified_on as last_modified_on, @last_modified_by as last_modified_by, MAX(li.grocery_price) as grocery_price, 1 as quantity, 0 as purchased FROM List_items li JOIN lists_new l ON l.list_id = li.list_id AND l.list_type = 10003 AND l.list_id IN (SELECT TOP 4 list_id l2 FROM lists_new l2 WHERE l2.owner_id = @owner_id AND l2.list_type = 10003 ORDER BY l2.list_id DESC) WHERE li.deleted = 0 GROUP BY li.list_item_content
